properties.displayName: UAV S48 - Modem/SATCOM Terminal Firmware Tampering
properties.description: 모뎀/SATCOM 터미널 펌웨어 변조 탐지 — UAVPgse_CL(preflight/GSE 해시·SBOM 검사 테이블, S16/S33과 동일 테이블 재사용)에서 Serial 또는 Reason 값이 모뎀/SATCOM 구성요소임을 나타내는 컨벤션(예: 'MODEM-', 'SATCOM-', 'SAT-' 접두)을 가진 레코드 중 HashMatch=false, SbomForbiddenCount>0, 또는 Passed=false인 경우를 탐지. 실제 컬럼: EventType, UAVId, Operator, Serial, ImageHashSubmitted, ImageHashExpected, HashMatch, SbomForbiddenCount, Passed, FailReason, Reason, StatusCode(UAVDatalinkInfra_CL/ReportedValue/IntegrityStatus/RemoteHost/DeviceId 컬럼은 존재하지 않아 제거함). MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0857 System Firmware
properties.query:
let modemSatcomMarkers = dynamic(["MODEM", "SATCOM", "SAT-"]);
let alertWindow = 1d;
UAVPgse_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where Serial has_any (modemSatcomMarkers) or Reason has_any (modemSatcomMarkers)
| where HashMatch == false or SbomForbiddenCount > 0 or Passed == false
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    HashMatch == false and SbomForbiddenCount > 0, "모뎀SATCOM_펌웨어_해시불일치_금지SBOM_동시",
    HashMatch == false, "모뎀SATCOM_펌웨어_해시_불일치",
    SbomForbiddenCount > 0, "모뎀SATCOM_펌웨어_금지_SBOM컴포넌트",
    "모뎀SATCOM_펌웨어_검증_실패")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, Operator, Serial, ImageHashSubmitted, ImageHashExpected, HashMatch, SbomForbiddenCount, Passed, FailReason, Reason, StatusCode, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S48 - Modem/SATCOM Terminal Firmware Tampering - {{Serial}}
